76 /** Options shared by both ways of entering interactive mode:
  77  * `code-shell repl` and the command-less `code-shell` default. Keeping these
  78  * in one builder prevents the two entry points from silently drifting apart. */
  79 function addInteractiveOptions(cmd: Command): Command {
  80   return cmd
  81     .option("--resume <sessionId>", "Resume a previous session")
  82     .option("--prefill <text>", "Pre-fill the input box without submitting");
  83 }

  87 addCommonOptions(

  90     .description(
  91       "Execute a single task (headless mode). Reads the task from stdin if omitted and piped.",
  92     )
  93     .argument("[task]", "The task to execute (or pipe it via stdin)"),
  94 )
  95   .option("--resume <sessionId>", "Resume a previous session")
  96   .option("--output-last-message <file>", "Write the final assistant message to a file")
  97   .option("--no-wait-background-agents", "Exit without waiting for in-flight background work")
  98   .option(
  99     "--background-wait-ms <ms>",
 100     "Max ms to wait for background work to finish (default: 300000)",
 101     positiveIntOption("--background-wait-ms"),
 102   )
 103   .action(async (task: string | undefined, opts) => {
 104     const resolvedTask = await resolveTaskFromArgOrStdin(task);
 105     if (!resolvedTask) {
 106       console.error("Error: no task provided. Pass a <task> argument or pipe a prompt via stdin.");
 107       process.exit(2);
 108     }
 109     await runCommand({
 110       task: resolvedTask,
 111       ...resolveOpts(opts),
 112       // Commander maps --no-wait-background-agents to waitBackgroundAgents=false.
 113       waitBackgroundAgents: opts.waitBackgroundAgents as boolean | undefined,
 114       backgroundWaitMs: opts.backgroundWaitMs as number | undefined,
 115     });
 116   });
